target.title: fix(clickclack): wrap websocket message rejections with Error for diagnostics
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The websocket message handler in ClickClack's gateway uses `.catch(reject)` to
forward errors from the async message processor. When the processor throws a
non-Error value (a plain string, `undefined`, or a deserialized error from a
remote system), the raw rejection loses the stack trace and makes downstream
error diagnostics unreliable.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replace `.catch(reject)` with an explicit catch block that preserves Error
instances and wraps non-Error values with context and the original value as
`cause`.

## Evidence

```text
$ pnpm test extensions/clickclack/src/gateway.test.ts

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  5 passed (5)
```

The http-client in the same extension already follows this pattern:
all thrown errors are `new Error(...)` instances.
